responsibility: Implements out-of-line constructors, copy/assignment logic, cloning, and small conversion helpers for concrete Rust HIR type nodes declared in `rust-hir-type.h`. It covers bound-carrying types such as `ImplTraitType` and `TraitObjectType`, no-bounds forms such as tuples, pointers, references, arrays, slices, inferred and parenthesized types, and function-type parameter payloads, preserving nested HIR subtrees, source locations, and `Analysis::NodeMapping` data used by later semantic stages.
same_name_distinction: Implements out-of-line behavior for the concrete HIR type nodes declared in `rust-hir-type.h`, including constructors, copy/assignment, deep-cloning, and selected conversions such as parenthesized-type trait-bound forwarding. Unlike `rust-hir-type-abstract.cc`, it covers concrete type forms rather than the abstract base hook, and unlike the header it does not define the type classes themselves.
